name: Critical Skills Employment Permit (CSEP)

requirement_groups.name: General (Critical Skills Occupations List, with relevant degree)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires an occupation on the Critical Skills Occupations List with a relevant degree, and a salary of at least €40,904/year (from 1 March 2026).
requirements.fix_path: Secure a qualifying role and salary.

requirement_groups.name: Eligible job not on the list (no degree required)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a salary of at least €68,911/year (from 1 March 2026) for an eligible job not on the Critical Skills Occupations List, no degree required.
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a salary meeting the threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a salary of at least €36,848/year for a job on the Critical Skills list, where the applicant's qualification was obtained within the prior 12 months.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract meeting the applicable salary threshold

sources.title: Critical Skills Employment Permit - Department of Enterprise, Trade and Employment

notes: FORMULA VALUES, tier-1 confirmed, part of a live multi-year DETE roadmap of increases phased through 2030 (index-linked to CSO average earnings, historically ~4.9%/yr) — the 1 March 2026 figures (€40,904 general / €68,911 no-degree / €36,848 recent-graduate) replace €38,000 / €64,000 respectively. No Labour Market Needs Test — a genuine advantage over ie_general_employment_permit. Immediate family reunification: spouse/de-facto partner gets Stamp 1G (work without a permit) directly, a more generous outcome than most other work-sponsored routes in this dataset provide for spouses. pr_after_months (21) reflects the relaxed CSEP-specific rule reinstated 3 April 2024 — applying directly to Stamp 4 after 21 months of employment, no renewal permit needed, genuinely faster than the standard employment-permit-to-Stamp-4 path (57 months, see ie_general_employment_permit).
